status: Playable v0.4.0 includes six selectable fighters with dodge/counters and aerial moves, plus Pac-Man, H4CK3R (penultimate), Dark lord (final) and camera-bug helpers. Other entries remain future concepts.

characters.name: Alan Becker
characters.proposal: Giant cursor draws platforms and drops tools. Later boss or special mode.

characters.name: Dark lord’s camera bug
characters.proposal: Scuttles, marks a target, then fires a clearly signaled beam.
characters.implemented_behavior: Two visible camera-bug helpers accompany the Dark lord. Marked columns warn before a damaging beam; the Dark lord is immune to his own marks. This helper is not selectable, and the proposed scuttling movement is not implemented.

characters.name: H4CK3R
characters.proposal: Glitch step and a temporary decoy. Keep the Victim reference with this entry for review.
characters.implemented_behavior: Fifth of six story opponents, 190 HP: title-inspired tilted monitor, cyan camera eye, cables, pale armor and handheld tablet; cursor melee, packet shot, cursor stamp, eraser and ink patterns. Not selectable. Decoy remains a future concept.

characters.name: Red
characters.proposal: Large hammer; a ground slam sends a short shockwave.
characters.implemented_behavior: Selectable hammer fighter with ground-wave special; second journey opponent, harder than Blue. Also has a shared timed dodge/counter and a character-specific airborne basic attack.

characters.name: Green
characters.proposal: Oversized pixel sword; a forward dash slash.
characters.implemented_behavior: Selectable pixel-sword fighter with dash-slash special; third journey opponent, harder than Red. Also has a shared timed dodge/counter and a character-specific airborne basic attack.

characters.name: Orange
characters.proposal: Pitchfork; a broad spin attack. Preselected for first play.
characters.implemented_behavior: Selectable pitchfork fighter with a broad spin special. Preselected for a fresh profile; later launches restore the saved fighter. Also has a shared timed dodge/counter and a character-specific airborne basic attack.

characters.name: Pac-man
characters.proposal: Short chomp dash and a bouncing pellet.
characters.implemented_behavior: Fourth of six story opponents, 150 HP: faster serrated yellow creature with warned bites, charged dashes, pellet fans and leaping chomps. Not selectable.

characters.name: Sign guy
characters.proposal: Large sign works as a shield and a push attack.

characters.name: Purple
characters.proposal: Pointy arrows and a short burst shot.
characters.implemented_behavior: Selectable bow fighter: basic arrows and a long-range Signal shot, plus bow-draw animation and a decorative shield. Also has a shared timed dodge/counter and a character-specific airborne basic attack.

characters.name: Blue
characters.proposal: Pickaxe; a slam throws a small block fragment.
characters.implemented_behavior: Selectable pickaxe fighter with block-fragment special; gentle first journey opponent. Also has a shared timed dodge/counter and a character-specific airborne basic attack.

characters.name: Dark lord
characters.proposal: Oversized dark blade, camera bugs, and slow powerful attacks.
characters.implemented_behavior: Final sixth story boss, 240 HP and 50% bigger: ragged black/purple crowned figure with scythe sweeps, ground waves, void volleys, rising rifts and camera hazards. Finite damage-taking windup guard, then recovery. Not selectable.

characters.name: Yellow
characters.proposal: A temporary block turret or a simple trap.
characters.implemented_behavior: Selectable small staff fighter: quick melee swings and Swarm summon, three moving doodle helpers sharing one damage hitbox. This follows the later user-supplied special-attack illustration. Also has a shared timed dodge/counter and a character-specific airborne basic attack.

source_notes: The proposal fields preserve the original ideas. implementation_status and implemented_behavior describe the current playable build.
Characters depicted in the supplied introductory poster beyond the implemented roster are illustration, not locked playable content.
Alan Becker is the corrected reference name. Proposed as the animator/cursor role, not an extra colored fighter.
Green appeared twice in the supplied list. Keep one playable entry until a distinct second Green is identified.
The Victim wiki link is a reference associated with H4ck3r for review, not an automatically added extra fighter.
Weapon assignments and powers are game design suggestions, not statements of series canon.
The block-armored figure and several unlabeled figures in the photograph still need names from the children.
